title: Wing and Pylon Wiring — Trailing Edge Harnesses and Engine Control Feeds
abstract: Wiring diagram for the trailing edge harnesses and the engine control feeds through the pylon, showing both electronic control channel routes and the separation required inside the designated fire zone.

sections.purpose: Wiring diagram of the wing trailing edge harnesses and the engine electronic control feeds through the pylon into the fan case, showing both channel routes.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking inboard at the left hand pylon and fan case. Both electronic control channels are shown: channel A at the four o'clock position and channel B at the eight o'clock position on the re-routed standard, with the original common bundle greyed. The designated fire zone boundary is drawn on the sheet, because the clamp standard and the sleeving requirement change at that line and neither is visible once the cowls are closed.
sections.routing_note: Channel A follows the original route from the pylon disconnect along the four o'clock side. Channel B leaves the disconnect and crosses the pylon underside to the eight o'clock side through the six support brackets shown, then runs aft to the control unit. The minimum separation between the two channels is given along the whole exposed length and must be measured along the run, not only at the ends.
